# Garsdale Radio Dispatch - trunked groups

Shared folder for the control room.

- groups/  loading sheets for each talk group
- masts/  coverage notes from the field team

turns.prompt: A controller at Garsdale Radio Dispatch is checking a group against its call profile; one Erlang is one channel busy for a full hour, so the traffic a group carries is its call minutes in the hour divided by sixty. Group T-24 takes 96 calls in the busy hour at a mean holding time of 3.25 minutes. Give the traffic that group carries, as a single number in Erlangs with no unit in the reply. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
